title: Halting on every choice string
statement: Let $A$ be a nondeterministic register program, let an oracle and a Boolean input string $x$ be fixed, and let $G$ be a predicate on configurations. For a natural number $N$, every choice string of length $N$ makes the run from the given configuration halt after those choices; moreover, at every time $t<N$ for which the run using the first $t$ choices has not halted, its configuration satisfies $G$.
